description.narrative: This project aims to strengthen the care of sick and premature neonates and support human milk banking in India. Furthermore, health personnel will be empowered in collaborative work in different cultural settings with diverging levels of resources and varying challenges. the latter will be aparticullar focus for the Norwegian partner OUS. There will also be a focus on teaching the teacher.This projects therefor seeks to ensure the delivery of essential new-born care providing vital attention to all infants during the crucial days following birth by improving the knowledge and skillset of nurses in the neonatal intensive care unit at LHMC & KSCH. NICU nurses coming to OUH get the opportunity to see the full spectrum of treatments and care, including several that are not yet fully implemented in India. Some of these treatments are planned to be introduced with help from OUH, during the next three years. The Indian exchange staff will be exposed to different routines, organization, and teamwork and more.
